picks.name: Polygonia / Melatonin Man
picks.bio: "Black Swords / Timeless Time" (September 4, 2026, cat. NOUS051) pairs two label favorites: Polygonia's "Black Swords" on the A-side, Melatonin Man's "Timeless Time" on the B.
picks.why_listen: A straightforward two-tracker from a label that's been reliable all year -- solid, driving material to slot alongside your other Nous'klaer picks.

picks.name: Little Simz
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Sugar Girl" (May 8, 2026) is a four-track EP on AWAL, produced with longtime collaborator Jakwob -- That's A No No, Game On (feat. JT), Open Arms (feat. Deela), Telephone (feat. 070 Shake) -- pushing further into club-focused, genre-bending production than her usual rap output.
picks.why_listen: A rare dancefloor-facing move from an artist you already know for sharp lyricism -- an all-women-featured EP with real electronic textures and dancefloor energy.
